items.summary: I've noticed the same pattern across three different Claude-coded projects now. Initial velocity is strong, but starts to fade until returns are negative. It seems a combination of changes in model behavior and increasing code base size—emphasis on the latter. The larger the code base and documented history/progress (e.g. through updates to completed work and instructions, as in .md files), the more drift starts to set in.
